verdicts.reason: A keeps the original left-to-right order of product badge, headline and CTA. However, 'Out now.' sits far below the headline with a big gap, the 'Try It' pill floats in the middle of that gap and almost touches the headline, and the pill sits only about 18px from the right edge of the canvas. B breaks up the original layout: the 'Out now.' subline is pulled away from its headline and placed beside the button, and the button butts directly against the bottom of the product circle. All the weight is crammed into the right half while the lower left is dead space, so the reading order runs from headline to product to CTA and then back to the subline.
